title: Prediction of the Vaccine-derived Poliovirus Outbreak Incidence: A Hybrid Machine Learning Approach.
summary: The actual result is retrospective classification of serology/antibody patterns associated with historical Lao VDPV outbreaks; it does not establish prospective outbreak forecasting. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
